page.title: Self-diagnostics
page.lead: The server checks its own database, storage, runners, disk, certificates, backups and background jobs. Every check has a status, a reason and a hint on what to do.

loadFailed: Could not load the check state.
notChecked: Not checked yet: the first pass runs within minutes.

summary.noneBody: The server runs the first scheduled pass on its own; you can press “Check now”.

okReason.database: The database answers in {{latency_ms}} ms, Postgres {{version}}.
okReason.migrations: The database schema is at the current revision.
okReason.object_storage: A probe object was written and read in {{roundtrip_ms}} ms.
okReason.scheduler: A leader is present, background jobs run.
okReason.tls_public: The certificate is valid for {{days_left}} more days.
okReason.tls_s3: The certificate is valid for {{days_left}} more days.
okReason.backups: The last backup was {{age_hours}} h ago.

reason.check_timeout: The check did not finish in {{seconds}} s.
reason.check_error: The check failed with an error ({{error}}).
reason.migrations_missing: The database has no migration revision recorded.
reason.migrations_ahead: The database was migrated by a newer version ({{current}}) than this one ({{head}}).
reason.migrations_behind: The database lags behind the code: {{current}}, needs {{head}}.
reason.object_write_failed: The probe object cannot be written.
reason.object_read_failed: The probe object was written but cannot be read.
reason.object_mismatch: The object read back differs from the one written.
reason.object_not_public: {{runners}} runner(s) outside the server network, but the storage has no public address: their builds cannot upload results.
reason.no_runners: No shared runner is registered: builds do not run.
reason.no_online_runner: No runner is online ({{registered}} registered, {{queued}} queued).
reason.jobs_stuck: Stuck jobs: {{stuck}}, the oldest is overdue by {{oldest_overdue_s}} s.
reason.disk_warning: Volume “{{volume}}” is running out of space: {{percent}}% used.
reason.tls_expiring: The certificate of {{host}} expires in {{days_left}} days.
reason.tls_unreachable: Could not check the certificate of {{host}} ({{error}}).
reason.no_tls: {{host}} is served without TLS: there is no certificate.
reason.backups_never: There has been no successful backup yet.
reason.backups_stale: The last successful backup is {{age_hours}} h old.
reason.no_leader: No background-job leader found: periodic jobs do not run.
reason.heartbeat_stale: The scheduled check has not reported for {{seconds}} s.
reason.task_stale: Jobs have not run for a long time: {{tasks}}.

hint.unknown: Open the server log (docker compose logs api) and run the check again.
hint.check_timeout: Check the network to the service and the host load, then run the check again.
hint.check_error: See the server log for the full reason.
hint.db_unreachable: Make sure the Postgres container is running and HSE_STUDIO__DB__* is right; see docker compose logs db.
hint.db_slow: Check host disk and CPU load and connection count; as the database grows, add resources or clean data in “Data retention”.
hint.migrations_missing: Run migrations: docker compose run --rm api migrate (or restart api, it migrates on start).
hint.migrations_ahead: The api image is older than the database schema. Run a version at least as new as the one that migrated the database, or restore from a backup.
hint.migrations_behind: Restart api: it applies migrations under a lock. If that does not help, run them by hand.
hint.object_unreachable: Check the address, keys and bucket in HSE_STUDIO__S3__*, and that MinIO or S3 is up and reachable from the api container.
hint.object_write_failed: Check that the key may write and that the storage has free space.
hint.object_read_failed: Check that the key may read and that the storage is intact.
hint.object_mismatch: Data is corrupted on the way: check the proxy in front of S3 and the storage disk.
hint.object_slow: Check the network to the storage and its load.
hint.object_not_public: Publish S3 and set HSE_STUDIO__S3__PUBLIC_ENDPOINT (see “Runners outside the server network” in the docs), or enable HSE_STUDIO__S3__OUTSIDE_RUNNER_ACCESS=proxy so that outside runners exchange files through the api.
hint.no_runners: Register a runner: “Runners” → registration token, then start the runner container.
hint.no_online_runner: Start or restart runners (docker compose up -d runner); check the token and the network to api.
hint.jobs_stuck: The runner that held the jobs is gone. Check runners; the reaper returns the jobs to the queue on its own if the background leader is alive.
hint.queue_wait: Add runners, raise their concurrency or turn on autoscaling.
hint.disk_critical: Free space now: “Data retention” → shorten retention and clean sources, grow the volume. Large uploads are rejected meanwhile.
hint.disk_warning: Shorten retention in “Data retention” or grow the volume before the space runs out.
hint.lifecycle_failing: Open “Data retention”: the failing source shows the message of its last run.
hint.tls_expired: Reissue the certificate and reload the proxy. Browsers already refuse the connection.
hint.tls_expiring: Renew the certificate (check auto-renewal in the proxy or ACME client) before it expires.
hint.tls_unreachable: The address did not open from the api container. If your proxy is not reachable from inside, this is not an error; otherwise check DNS and the port.
hint.backups_disabled: Turn on the schedule on the “Backups” page: without copies a lost disk is lost data.
hint.backups_no_destination: Add a destination (S3 or a folder on a separate volume) on the “Backups” page.
hint.backups_never: Take the first backup by hand on the “Backups” page and check the schedule.
hint.backups_stale: Check the run history on the “Backups” page and take a backup by hand.
hint.backups_last_failed: Open the run history on the “Backups” page: it shows the reason.
hint.smtp_unreachable: Check the host, port, security mode and password in the mail settings. While SMTP is down, admins hand out links by hand.
hint.no_leader: Restart api. If there is still no leader, check the database connection: leadership is a database lock.
hint.heartbeat_stale: The leader runs in another instance and has not reported for long: check its log and the database.
hint.task_stale: Restart api; if it repeats, read the log: a background job is stuck.
hint.task_failing: Read the api log for the job name: it fails on every run.

thresholds.title: Thresholds and notifications
thresholds.lead: When latency, queue wait, certificate age and backup age count as a warning or a failure, and how not to flood admins with notices.
thresholds.invalid: Check the values: within bounds, warning before failure.
thresholds.rowInvalid: Allowed from {{min}} to {{max}}; warning before failure (for the certificate: more days ahead).

hint.confirm_runs: How many checks in a row a status must hold before admins are notified. Guards against flapping.
hint.repeat_hours: At most this often while the problem persists.

notify.label: Notify admins
notify.hint: An inbox message when a check turns into a warning or failure, and when it recovers.

accept.button: I accept: this is on purpose
accept.title: Accept the warning: {{check}}
accept.lead: Confirm that you knowingly live with this warning.
accept.consequences: An accepted warning stops counting as a problem: its status turns grey "Accepted", and the menu dot, the overview line, banners and admin notifications go away. The check keeps running: if things get worse and it fails, you will see that as usual.
accept.reasonHint: Why, in a few words: {{count}} of {{max}}
accept.revertHint: You can undo it at any time: "Bring the warning back" in the "Accepted warnings" section of the Self-diagnostics page. Accepting and undoing are written to the audit log.
accept.submit: I accept: this is on purpose
accept.failed: Could not accept: this warning cannot be accepted or is already fixed. Reload the page.

accepted.title: Accepted warnings
accepted.lead: Warnings you agreed to live with. They stay out of the overall status, the menu, notifications and alerts; metrics remain, flagged accepted.
accepted.dormantHint: The cause is fixed: the record stays but silences nothing.
